verdict.rationale: The aihero.dev/skills page lists the product's 25–27 skills with one-line descriptions (e.g. 'Turn an agreed conversation into a written spec', 'Diagnose a hard bug…'). It invites users to 'Pick the skills… you use' and 'Install the ones you want'. The probe confirms selective single-skill install, so browsing before installing is supported, and the bundle is also listed in Claude Code's official plugin marketplace. However, this is only a curated listing of one author's own set, not a searchable registry, leaderboard or marketplace. Missing for 10: search or filtering, a registry or leaderboard beyond its own skills, and independent corroboration of the browsing experience.
